name: executive-assistant
description: Configurable executive assistant for productivity workflow automation. Gmail and Calendar via Google Workspace MCP, plus Slack, Jira, Linear, and markdown notes in a folder you configure.

notes_vault_path.title: Notes vault path
notes_vault_path.description: Root folder of your markdown notes. Leave empty to disable notes.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone used for calendar and daily-note dates, e.g. America/Toronto.

google_oauth_client_id.title: Google OAuth client ID
google_oauth_client_id.description: OAuth client ID for the Google Workspace MCP server (Gmail + Calendar).

google_oauth_client_secret.title: Google OAuth client secret
google_oauth_client_secret.description: OAuth client secret for the Google Workspace MCP server.

notes_daily_folder.title: Daily notes subfolder
notes_daily_folder.description: Subfolder for daily notes, relative to the vault path.

working_hours_start.title: Working hours start
working_hours_start.description: Start of your working day in 24-hour HH:MM, used for timeboxing and free-block detection.

working_hours_end.title: Working hours end
working_hours_end.description: End of your working day in 24-hour HH:MM.

enabled_integrations.title: Enabled integrations
enabled_integrations.description: Which sources daily-prep runs. Choose any of: gmail, calendar, slack, jira, linear, notes.

assistant_name.title: Assistant name
assistant_name.description: What the assistant calls itself when greeting you.

personality_preset.title: Personality preset
personality_preset.description: Tone preset from config/presets/, e.g. warm. Leave empty for the neutral professional default.

response_style.title: Response style
response_style.description: How the assistant talks to you. 'conversational' (default) uses plain language and short sentences with minimal formatting. 'structured' allows headed sections and tables.
